name: Lingering Fireball
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level magus 6, sorcerer/wizard 6

Duration 3 rounds

This spell functions as fireball, except that the flames linger in the area for 3 rounds. Any creature beginning their turn in or entering the area take the fireball damage again. A successful Reflex save halves this damage.
